object.name: evi_rampsmooth
object.digest: Reimplementation of MSP <o>rampsmooth~</o> in gen abstraction form
object.description: evi_rampsmooth is identical to an MSP <o>rampsmooth~</o> where it's ramp inlets are fed by signals (ramp times only update if input value changes), providing exact ramps in the given destination times. The algorithm is slightly different to account for efficiency in the gen~ domain, but it seems to work well. Based on the original gen~ example by Maurizio Giri and Graham Wakefield. See <o>evi_rampsmoothupdate</o> for an alternative.

inlets.name: target
inlets.digest: Input value to be smoothly ramped.

inlets.name: ramp
inlets.digest: Amount of time the value takes to reach it's up destination. Only updates if input value (inlet 1) changes. evi_rampsmooth reaches it's up destination exactly in this time.

inlets.name: ramp
inlets.digest: Amount of time the value takes to reach it's down destination. Only updates if input value (inlet 1) changes. evi_rampsmooth reaches it's down destination exactly in this time.

outlets.name: exact
outlets.digest: Smoothed output ramp, or target value if envelope is complete.

outlets.digestauto: When Env Reaches Destination (0 During Env)
outlets.digest: 1 When Envelope Reaches Destination (0 During Envelope).
